scripts.dev: npm run prepare:config && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.dev:local: npm run prepare:config && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run prepare:config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm run migrate:remote && npm run deploy:worker && npm run smoke:remote
scripts.test:setup: npm run prepare:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply rawaj-staging --local --persist-to .wrangler/test-state-auth --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.test:fixtures: wrangler d1 execute rawaj-staging --local --persist-to .wrangler/test-state-auth --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --file test/marketplace-fixtures.sql
scripts.pretest: npm run test:setup && npm run test:fixtures
scripts.migrate:local: npm run prepare:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply rawaj-staging --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: npm run prepare:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply rawaj-staging --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
